dean: Heads-up — after yesterday's FP8 calibration tweak, we're seeing per-token tail latency regressions on short sequences (<=32). Kernel counters show an increase in `fallback_to_fp32` for matmul kernels. perf trace: perf-bot posted sample.

anna: Is the fallback happening at kernel selection time or during execution? Any batch-size correlation?

dean: Looks like selection time: sampler chooses FP8 variant but the kernel aborts on small dims and falls back. Batcher heuristic also changed windowing; more small batches are getting through.

priya: Do you have the per-token breakdown? That'll tell if copy/launch overhead or compute.

dean: Yep — snippet from `perf-bot`:
```
per_token: {
  kv_lookup_ms: 0.18,
  kernel_launch_ms: 0.35,
  compute_ms: 0.60,
  fallback_overhead_ms: 0.42
}
cache_hit_rate: 0.71
kernel_counters: {
  fp8_selected: 12456,
  fp8_failed: 982,
  fallback_to_fp32: 982,
  int8_selected: 3400
}
```

matt: So FP8 fails ~7.9% of the time when selected — that's not negligible. If failure triggers an extra kernel launch compute is doubled sometimes.

priya: What's the pattern for failures? sequence length, head dims, quant-scale outliers?

dean: Early signal points to per-head scale calibration hitting NaNs for short contexts. Our cali sampler trimmed extreme batches; seems we over-pruned which makes scale estimates unstable for some micro-batches.

anna: Could be the `calib_sample_percentile` we bumped from 95->98. That reduces data diversity.

dean: Exactly. Reverting to 95 reduced `fp8_failed` to ~220 in local repro.

perf-bot: @channel reproduction steps saved: `bench/repro/1869998888.sh` with env `CALI_PCTL=98` and `BATCHER_WINDOW_MS=12`.

matt: Batcher window change — small window => more tiny pads => more short seqs hitting fp8. Maybe increase min_batch_size or prefer INT8 for seq<=32.

priya: Suggestion: in kernel selection add a fast pre-check: if seq_len<=32 && model_head_dim % 64 != 0 => prefer int8. Cheap and reduces fallback.

dean: Agreed. I'll prototype selector patch. Also add counter `calib_sampled_bins` so we can observe sampler entropy.

anna: Can we update observability dashboard: show per-token breakdown split by `kernel_variant` and `cache_hit`? We'll want charts: p50/p95/p99 of `kernel_launch` and `compute`.

dean: I'll add telemetry events: `quant_variant`, `fallback_reason`, `calib_percentile`, and `kv_cache_hit`.

matt: Also collect `batcher_effective_batch_size` and `pad_ratio` to correlate.

priya: Timeline: Dean to push quick selector guard + telemetry by EOD, we'll rerun nightly perf and check.

dean: Working on PR. Minimal change: selector returns `INT8` for short sequences unless `fp8_confidence>0.9`.

perf-bot: CI check queued. bench run scheduled at 03:00 UTC. I'll post results in the thread when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anna: Thanks. This is a good example of calibration affecting runtime heuristics. Keep notes for postmortem.

matt: One-liner for runbook: if FP8 failed rate >5% for 1h, revert `CALI_PCTL` and throttle fp8 selection for seq<=32.

priya: ok locking that in.

dean: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4123 — includes selector guard + new metrics.

perf-bot: Nightly results: `fp8_failed` dropped from 982 -> 210, median per-token latency p95 improved by 12% on short seqs. Full logs: s3://rwd-perf/1869998888/results.json

anna: Nice. Closing loop: we'll still evaluate longer term if we can make calib sampler more robust rather than reverting percentile.

matt: Agreed. Great triage team. :thumbsup:
